notes.title: Daily update
notes.notes:
This update may cause the downloaded files to be somewhat large
New compression and optimization algorithms have been used for the textures of the game, with the aim of reducing the demands on computer performance and file size
Fixed an issue with unstable interlocking detonations of bombs and made "nanoshell" the default setting where bombs would no longer be detonated by other bombs
Fixed the issue of Divine Sword's punishment decision
Now the game has added medical packs, which can be picked up directly to restore the character's strength
Added screen effects after injury

notes.title: Daily update
notes.notes:
Added teaching
Improved full screen display and field of view distance, now characters can see longer distances

notes.title: Daily update
notes.notes:
The wave function collapse algorithm is modified and the randomness of block size is adjusted
Added the "Air Defense Trap" card
Changed the difficulty of some scenes

notes.title: Daily update
notes.notes:
The game now has a more realistic lighting effect. If this change is not satisfactory to some players, please let me know
Increased the character's initial movement speed
Modified the UI interface during upgrade

notes.title: Daily update
notes.notes:
Added a card collection where players can view all the cards in the game from where they were born
Fixed an issue where guards would appear when the player did not select a card

notes.title: Daily update
notes.notes:
Adjusted the difficulty of the upper level area, now the difficulty is reduced
Tweaked the remote-controlled bomb restrictions, which no longer require the number of bombs
Added a guard card that allows players to recruit a guard

notes.title: Daily update
notes.notes: The game now includes visual backpacks that allow players to view their cards as they play

notes.title: Daily Update
notes.notes:
Fixed several issues:
1. Fixed the issue of updating the visual prompts on the page
2. Fixed the Holy Staff render level blocking issue
3. The adaptation of the full-screen display is fixed

notes.title: Daily Update
notes.notes:
Fixed some bugs:
1. Fixed long distance between remote controlled bombs
2. Fixed ice bombs causing characters to get stuck
3. Fixed UI display issues in the store
4. Fixed an issue with the Knell card
